Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some figures are numbers.

Some numbers are digits.

**Conclusions:**

I. No figure is a digit.

II. All digits are figures.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ab67b2fa152bc258761c12438daad649865977a31613345b5183df9fc01ee8c.png] 

**Conclusions:**

**I. No figure is a digit** →** **Does not follow → There are some figures that are numbers and there are some numbers that are digits so there is an indirect relation between figure and digit which cannot be ignored, and that relation suggest that some figures are digits and thus the conclusion does not follow.

**II. All digits are figures** → Does not follow → From the statements, we have that 'some figures are numbers' and 'some numbers are digits' so there is no information that suggests that all digits are figures also in the diagram we can see that figures and digits are not related directly and therefore the conclusion does not follow. 

So, **neither conclusion I nor II follows**.

Hence,** 'option 2'** is the correct answer.

questions.question: A and B can complete a piece of work in 12 days and 18 days, respectively. A begins to do the work and they work alternately, one at a time, for one day each. The whole work will be completed in ________.

**Given:**

A and B can complete a piece of work in 12 days and 18 days

A begins to do the work and they work alternately, one at a time, for one day each

**Formula Used:**

Total work= time taken x efficiency

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total work = LCM of 12 and 18= 36 

⇒ A can complete work= 12 days

⇒ Work does in one day= (36)/(12) = 3 unit

⇒ B can complete work= 18 days

⇒ Work does in one day= (36)/(18)= 2 unit

As they work for alternate days,

⇒ In 2 days work completed is

⇒ ⇒ 2 days= 3 unit + 2 unit

⇒ 2 days= 5 unit

⇒ 14 days= 35 unit 

⇒ The remaining work = 36 - 35= 1

⇒ On the last day, A has to work= (1)/(3)days

⇒ Total days= 14 days + (1)/(3)days= 14(1)/(3) days

**Hence, The total work is completed in 14(1)/(3) days**
